description: API-side SEO data model + server-side crawler endpoints. Adds guarded SEO columns (products.seo_title/seo_description/seo_keywords/og_image, pages.meta_keywords, config.seo LONGTEXT) via a NEW guarded SQL file + schema.prisma mirror; surfaces per-product SEO (ADD-only in GET /api/products & /api/products/:id) and global config.seo (ADD-only in GET /api/config) with sensible defaults; adds admin write paths (per-product SEO via productSchema, page keywords via pageSchema/toPage, global via POST /api/admin/seo) under requireStaff('settings'); adds a shared local-SEO/JSON-LD helper; EXTENDS og.ts shareHtml for full crawler meta (title/description/keywords/robots/canonical/OG/Twitter + Product/BreadcrumbList/Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD); adds a seoRouter serving GET /api/sitemap.xml and GET /api/robots.txt; adds the seoModule feature flag (API side). Independent of FEAT-002/003 except that FEAT-002 consumes config.seo + new product fields and FEAT-003 documents these endpoints — so this feature MUST come first.
steps: Create 4astore-v2/api-node/prisma/seo.sql with the header comment block (run line `mysql -u <user> -p four_a_store < prisma/seo.sql`; 'Run ONCE on the live DB (EC2). ADD COLUMN only — no destructive ops.') and ONE information_schema-guarded PREPARE/EXECUTE/DEALLOCATE block per column, copying the exact style of prisma/charges-settings.sql: products.seo_title VARCHAR(255) NULL, products.seo_description TEXT NULL, products.seo_keywords VARCHAR(500) NULL, products.og_image VARCHAR(500) NULL, pages.meta_keywords VARCHAR(500) NULL, config.seo LONGTEXT NULL. All nullable, ADD-only, re-runnable.

In 4astore-v2/api-node/prisma/schema.prisma, add to model Product (after `features`): seo_title String? @db.VarChar(255), seo_description String? @db.Text, seo_keywords String? @db.VarChar(500), og_image String? @db.VarChar(500). Then run `npx prisma generate` so the typed client returns the new nullable fields.

Add the seoModule flag in 4astore-v2/api-node/src/utils/features.ts: append 'seoModule' to the FeatureKey union and the FEATURE_KEYS array, add `seoModule: true` to DEFAULT_FEATURES. (config GET + /features POST iterate FEATURE_KEYS/mergeFeatures — no other wiring.)

Create 4astore-v2/api-node/src/seo/localSeo.ts exporting: LOCAL constants (storeName '4A Store', areaServed ['Chandargarh','Nabinagar','Aurangabad','Bihar'], pin '824301', keywordSeeds ['grocery delivery','kirana','online grocery','home delivery','sabzi','daily essentials']); interface SeoConfig { titleTemplate, defaultDescription, defaultKeywords, defaultOgImage, robotsExtra, social{whatsapp,instagram,facebook}, business{name,address,phone,geo{lat,lng},openingHours,priceRange,areaServed[]} }; defaultSeoConfig(settingsRow): SeoConfig (business defaults derived from settings row store_address/phone/store_latitude/store_longitude; titleTemplate '%s | 4A Store'; local defaultDescription/keywords from LOCAL); mergeSeoConfig(raw, settingsRow): SeoConfig; deriveProductSeo(product): {title,description,keywords} (title `${name} - ₹${price} | 4A Store`, description = first ~160 chars of stripped description or a generated local line, keywords from name/brand/category + keywordSeeds + areaServed); buildProductJsonLd(product, cfg, url), buildBreadcrumbJsonLd(items), buildOrganizationJsonLd(cfg), buildLocalBusinessJsonLd(cfg) returning schema.org objects. Keep all functions pure + typed.

In 4astore-v2/api-node/src/routes/catalog.ts GET /config: inside the cached('config', ...) loader fetch the settings row (SELECT * FROM settings WHERE id = 1) and add `seo: mergeSeoConfig(parse(row.seo), settingsRow)` to the returned object. Do NOT change any existing config key. Verify GET /products and /products/:id already pass the Prisma product through (new nullable columns ride along null-when-unset — no key removals).

In 4astore-v2/api-node/src/routes/admin.ts: extend productSchema with optional seoTitle/seoDescription/seoKeywords/ogImage (string, optional) and map into the add/update `data` object (seo_title: p.seoTitle || null, seo_description: p.seoDescription || null, seo_keywords: p.seoKeywords || null, og_image: p.ogImage || null). Extend pageSchema with optional metaKeywords (string, max 500); add meta_keywords to the pages INSERT/UPDATE column list + values array. Add router.post('/seo', requireAuth, requireStaff('settings'), ...) validating a Zod seoSchema that mirrors SeoConfig, then `UPDATE config SET seo = ? WHERE id = 1` with JSON.stringify; return ok with the saved config.

In 4astore-v2/api-node/src/routes/pages.ts: add meta_keywords to the PageRow interface and `metaKeywords: r.meta_keywords || ''` to toPage(), and include meta_keywords in the SELECT list of GET / (list query) if needed by consumers.

In 4astore-v2/api-node/src/routes/og.ts: widen interface ShareMeta with optional keywords?: string, robots?: string, jsonLd?: object[]. Update shareHtml() to render <meta name="keywords"> (when present), <meta name="robots"> (default 'index,follow'), keep <link rel=canonical>, and one <script type="application/ld+json"> per jsonLd entry (JSON.stringify, HTML-safe). In GET /product/:id build jsonLd = [buildProductJsonLd, buildBreadcrumbJsonLd, buildOrganizationJsonLd, buildLocalBusinessJsonLd] using deriveProductSeo for unset title/desc/keywords and absoluteImageUrl(product.og_image || product.image) for og:image. In GET /page/:slug add keywords (page.meta_keywords) + BreadcrumbList + LocalBusiness JSON-LD. Load config.seo once per request via a small raw-SQL read + mergeSeoConfig. Do NOT fork the file or duplicate the OG image generator.

Create 4astore-v2/api-node/src/routes/seo.ts default-exporting an Express Router: GET /sitemap.xml → valid XML urlset (homepage SITE_ORIGIN/, every product SITE_ORIGIN/product/:id with <lastmod> from updated_at, category URLs, all published CMS pages SITE_ORIGIN/page/:slug) with a short in-memory TTL cache; GET /robots.txt → User-agent: * / Allow: / / Sitemap: ${SITE_ORIGIN}/sitemap.xml + admin-editable extra lines from config.seo.robotsExtra. Reuse SITE_ORIGIN/API_ORIGIN (lift them into a small src/seo/origin.ts shared by og.ts + seo.ts, or re-declare identically). These routes must NOT be gated by the seoModule flag (crawlers always need them).
In 4astore-v2/api-node/src/server.ts: import seoRouter and mount it with app.use('/api', seoRouter) near the other /api routers so /api/sitemap.xml and /api/robots.txt resolve.
acceptance_criteria: `cd 4astore-v2/api-node && npx prisma validate` reports the schema is valid.
prisma/seo.sql contains only guarded information_schema PREPARE/EXECUTE/DEALLOCATE ADD COLUMN blocks (no destructive ops) and matches the charges-settings.sql guard style.
With the dev server running (npm run dev): `curl http://localhost:<port>/api/sitemap.xml` returns well-formed XML containing homepage + at least one product URL + CMS page URLs with <lastmod>.
`curl http://localhost:<port>/api/robots.txt` returns a body with 'User-agent', 'Allow' and a 'Sitemap:' line pointing at /sitemap.xml.

`curl -A 'Googlebot' http://localhost:<port>/api/og/product/1` returns HTML containing <title>, meta description, meta keywords, <link rel=canonical>, og:*/twitter:* tags, and JSON-LD with '"@type":"Product"' and '"@type":"LocalBusiness"'.
`curl http://localhost:<port>/api/products` response objects include seo_title/seo_description/seo_keywords/og_image (null when unset) and no previously-present key is removed.
`curl http://localhost:<port>/api/config` includes a `config.seo` object with sensible defaults even when the seo column is absent.
verification: Start `npm run dev` in api-node, then curl /api/sitemap.xml, /api/robots.txt, /api/og/product/1 (with -A Googlebot), /api/products, /api/config and confirm the acceptance criteria above; stop the dev server afterward.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED (tsc --noEmit clean, prisma validate OK, prisma generate OK, curl checks passed on a local dev server). Handoff for FEAT-002 (web storefront/admin) and FEAT-003 (docs):

== config.seo shape (GET /api/config -> config.seo) ==
Type SeoConfig in api-node/src/seo/localSeo.ts (exported). Shape returned by GET /api/config and GET-able fields the admin POST accepts:
{
  titleTemplate: string,            // e.g. '%s | 4A Store' — %s is the page/product title
  defaultDescription: string,
  defaultKeywords: string,          // comma-separated
  defaultOgImage: string,           // absolute URL; default `${SITE_ORIGIN}/assets/og-default.png`
  robotsExtra: string,              // newline-separated extra robots.txt lines (admin-editable)
  social: { whatsapp: string, instagram: string, facebook: string },
  business: {
    name: string, address: string, phone: string,
    geo: { lat: number, lng: number },
    openingHours: string,           // e.g. 'Mo-Su 07:00-21:00'
    priceRange: string,             // e.g. '₹'
    areaServed: string[]            // default ['Chandargarh','Nabinagar','Aurangabad','Bihar']
  }
}
mergeSeoConfig(raw, settingsRow) ALWAYS returns a complete object (business defaults derived from settings store_address/store_phone/store_latitude/store_longitude), so config.seo is NEVER null/partial even before prisma/seo.sql runs. defaultSeoConfig(settingsRow) gives the pure defaults.

== New product fields (GET /api/products & /api/products/:id, ADD-only) ==
product.seo_title: string|null, product.seo_description: string|null, product.seo_keywords: string|null, product.og_image: string|null (all null when unset; raw snake_case from Prisma). deriveProductSeo(product) in localSeo.ts returns {title,description,keywords} applying the admin override first, else a generated local line — REUSE this in the web ProductDetails Helmet instead of re-deriving. Admin write: POST /api/admin/products action add|update now accepts optional seoTitle/seoDescription/seoKeywords/ogImage (camelCase) on req.body.product.

== CMS page keyword field ==
pages.meta_keywords added (VARCHAR(500) NULL). toPage() in routes/pages.ts now returns metaKeywords: string (public GET /api/pages/:slug and admin GET /api/admin/pages). Admin write: POST /api/admin/pages accepts optional metaKeywords (max 500) on req.body.page. NOTE: the GET /api/pages LIST query deliberately does NOT select meta_keywords (footer list doesn't need it); per-page reads use SELECT * so it rides along.

== POST /admin/seo contract ==
POST /api/admin/seo (requireAuth + requireStaff('settings')). Body: either { seo: <SeoConfig partial> } or the SeoConfig fields at the top level. Partial payloads are fine (merged onto settings-derived defaults). Returns { success, seo: <full merged SeoConfig> } and persists JSON.stringify(seo) to config.seo. Web admin saver should mirror this and invalidate ['config'].

== sitemap / robots routes ==
GET /api/sitemap.xml (XML urlset: SITE_ORIGIN/, /category/:slug for non-hidden cats, /product/:id with <lastmod> from updated_at, /page/:slug for published pages; 5-min in-memory cache). GET /api/robots.txt (User-agent:* / Allow:/ / Disallow:/admin / Disallow:/api/ + config.seo.robotsExtra lines + Sitemap: ${SITE_ORIGIN}/sitemap.xml). Mounted at app.use('/api', seoRouter) in server.ts. These are NOT gated by the seoModule flag. nginx should map /sitemap.xml -> /api/sitemap.xml and /robots.txt -> /api/robots.txt (FEAT-003 to document in OG-SETUP.md).

== Shared helpers to REUSE (do not duplicate) ==
api-node/src/seo/origin.ts exports SITE_ORIGIN, API_ORIGIN (also re-exported from routes/og.ts for back-compat). api-node/src/seo/localSeo.ts exports LOCAL, SeoConfig, SeoBusiness, SeoSocial, SettingsRow, ProductLike, defaultSeoConfig, mergeSeoConfig, deriveProductSeo, buildProductJsonLd, buildBreadcrumbJsonLd, buildOrganizationJsonLd (uses @type Organization), buildLocalBusinessJsonLd (uses @type GroceryStore). og.ts shareHtml now accepts optional keywords/robots/jsonLd[]; JSON-LD is embedded via safeJsonLd (escapes <>& to \uXXXX). og.ts product route picks product.og_image over the generated card image when set.

== Feature flag ==
seoModule added to FeatureKey union + FEATURE_KEYS + DEFAULT_FEATURES (default ON) in api-node/src/utils/features.ts. FEAT-002 must add the matching flag+label in web/src/lib/features.ts.

== Local verification note ==
prisma/seo.sql is guarded/idempotent (2nd run prints 'already exists') and was applied to the LOCAL XAMPP four_a_store DB only for testing. The LIVE EC2 DB still needs it run manually (FEAT-003 deploy doc).
